name: Twisted Fates
source:
You will play as Ren (name can be changed), a barista in a cafe. One day, a strange girl comes to the cafe looking for you. Right after that moment, all sorts of troubles happen to you and your friends. Who is that girl, how could she bring so much trouble, how will Ren solve them?Join the world of Twisted Fates and find out!

[From [url=https://aigas.itch.io/twisted-fates]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演任（名字可以更改），一个咖啡馆的咖啡师。有一天，一位陌生的女孩来到咖啡馆找你。在那一刻之后，各种各样的麻烦就会发生在你和你的朋友身上。那个女孩是谁，她怎么会带来这么多麻烦，雷恩将如何解决他们？加入扭曲命运的世界，找出答案吧！

[来自[url=https://aigas.itch.io/twisted-fates]Itch.io[/url]]
